grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything here is a whole food or a plain cupboard staple: turnips, pumpkin, dried pasta, butter, hard cheese, lemon and herbs.

supermarket.reason: All the ingredients are everyday supermarket lines, and wholemeal penne and vegetarian hard cheese are standard own-brand items.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, a saucepan and a grater, with simple frying and boiling.

works.reason: 350g pasta with about 850g of veg suits four, and the pasta water, butter and cheese make a light sauce; a cook would naturally fry in a big pan or in batches to get the veg golden.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes to peel and dice the turnips and pumpkin, then grate, zest and chop while the veg fries, is realistic, and the 15-minute fry matches the cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item is used in the steps, wholemeal penne is a fair name for dried pasta, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm pasta built mostly on golden fried turnips suits a November lunch, and the turnips are clearly the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British instructions that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholemeal pasta with a generous amount of root veg, butter and cheese makes a filling, real-food lunch a family would eat again.
